이지유오 피스 스크립입니다.
;**************************************************
;Ceed's 0-120 Peacemaking Trainer v1.0.2a
;by Minoc Miner Murderer
;**************************************************

;PURPOSE: Peacemaking 8x8 trainer with anti-block

;FUNCTIONS: Obvious

;***************************************RELEASE NOTES*********************************************
;v1.0.0 - public release
;v1.0.1 - added code to reopen backpack upon crossing a server line
;v1.0.2 - event macro fix
;v1.0.2a - typo fix

;********************************************NOTES*****************************************************
;
;%shortdelay and %delay are my standard wait variables, if the script runs too fast for your
;conn/system try raising these
;
;%delay2 is the time (measured in seconds) that the script will pause to check for gains after
;each attempt, you may need to raise this in cases of extreme lag/latency
;
;%delay3 is the total time (mesured in seconds) between peacemake attempts
;
;%attps is the number of attemps that the script will execute on each tile before continuing on
;do NOT set this less than 2
;if you do, you're going to have problems with the 8x8 procedure
;
;%skipintro if set to 1 will bypass the title screen
;
;%cap is the skill level that you want the script to halt and lock your skill at
;
;***************************************Customizable variables****************************************

set %shortdelay 5
set %delay 15
set %delay2 3
set %delay3 11
set %attps 3
set %skipintro 0
set %cap 1000

;***********************************Edit nothing beyond this point************************************

chooseskill peace
set %orig #skill
set %lpcnt 0
set %move 1
set %skilltimer #scnt
set %baseskl #skill
set %atmp 0
set %svrln 0
set %fspt 0
set %dir 0
set %items QRF_NRF_MQF_PRF_LQF_OQF
set %skilltimer #scnt

initevents

event macro 8 7
wait %delay
contpos 610 375
wait %delay

menu clear

if %skipintro = 1
goto skipint

gosub introsetup
gosub intro
set %cnt -5
introloop1:
set %cnt %cnt + 5
set %cnt2 150 - %cnt
wait 1
gosub printtext
if %cnt < 60
goto introloop1
wait 2s
set %col 255
introloop2:
menu font color %col
set %col %col - 5
wait 1
gosub printtext
if %col > 0
goto introloop2

skipint:

gosub positions
gosub build_display

menu font style

begin:

gosub calculate
gosub initdisplay
gosub anti

menu delete STAT
menu text STAT %statx %staty Waiting...

if %move = 1 2
msg #smc Slow forward$
set %move 0

if %move = 2 10
menu delete STAT
menu text STAT %statx %staty Working
menu text EVENT %eventx %eventy Positioning boat...
if %dir = 0
gosub eightforward
if %dir = 1
gosub eightback
set %move 0
menu delete EVENT
menu delete STAT

if %move = 3 8
menu delete STAT
menu text STAT %statx %staty Working
menu text EVENT %eventx %eventy Positioning boat...
gosub eightback
gosub eightback
set %move 0
menu delete EVENT
menu delete STAT

if #scnt > %skilltimer 2
menu delete STAT
gosub peace

if #skill => %cap 6
menu delete STAT
menu delte EVENT
menu text STAT %statx %staty Completed
menu text EVENT %eventx %eventy Peacemaking now locked.
event skilllock music
halt

goto begin

;*******************************************SUBS*********************************************

sub peace

menu text STAT %statx %staty Working
menu text EVENT %eventx %eventy Peacemaking
set %curskl #skill
event macro 13 9
target
if WHAT_INSTRUMENT_SHALL in #sysmsg
gosub new_instrument
event macro 23
set %skilltimer #scnt + %delay3
set %temp #scnt + %delay2
set %lpcnt %lpcnt + 1

check_for_gain:

if %atmp = 0 6
if #skill > %curskl 5
msg #smc Stop$
set %atmp 1
set %move 2
set %fspt 0
goto exithd

if %atmp <= %attps 4
if #skill > %curskl 3
set %atmp 1
set %move 2
goto exithd

if #scnt < %temp
goto check_for_gain

exithd:

if %atmp = %attps 10
if #skill = %curskl 3
set %atmp 0
set %dir 0
set %move 1
if %fspt = 1 4
set %atmp 1
set %dir 1
set %move 3
set %fspt 0
goto exithd2

if %atmp <> 0 3
if #skill = %curskl 2
set %atmp %atmp + 1
set %move 0

exithd2:

menu delete STAT
menu delete EVENT

return

sub eightforward

msg #smc One forward$
wait %delay
msg #smc One forward$
wait %delay
msg #smc One forward$
wait %delay
msg #smc One forward$
wait %delay
msg #smc One forward$
wait %delay
msg #smc One forward$
wait %delay
msg #smc One forward$
wait %delay
msg #smc One forward$
wait %delay
set %fspt %fspt + 1

return

sub eightback

msg #smc One back$
wait %delay
msg #smc One back$
wait %delay
msg #smc One back$
wait %delay
msg #smc One back$
wait %delay
msg #smc One back$
wait %delay
msg #smc One back$
wait %delay
msg #smc One back$
wait %delay
msg #smc One back$
wait %delay
return

sub anti

set %charx #charposx
set %chary #charposy

if #charposx = %charx 5
if #charposy = %chary 4
for %i 1 3 3
scanjournal %i
if stopped in #journal
gosub blocked

for %i 1 3 4
scanjournal %i
if turbulent in #journal 6
set %svrln 1
gosub blocked
event macro 8 7
wait %delay
contpos 610 375
wait %delay

return


sub blocked

menu delete STAT
menu text STAT %statx %staty Working
menu text EVENT %eventx %eventy Positioning boat...
if %svrln = 1 4
msg #smc Right$
wait 80
msg #smc Slow forward$
wait 100

msg #smc Back$
wait 60
msg #smc Left$
wait 180
msg #smc Forward$
wait 160
msg #smc Right$
wait 180
msg #smc Slow forward$
wait 100

if %svrln = 1 4
msg #smc Left$
wait 80
msg #smc Slow forward$
set %svrln 0

menu delete STAT
menu delete EVENT

return

menu clear
menu window size 400 200
menu window title Ceed's 0-120 Peacemaking Trainer v1.0.2a

menu font color RED

menu show

sub build_display
menu window size 400 50
menu window title Ceed's 0-120 Peacemaking Trainer v1.0.2a
menu window color black
menu font bgcolor black
menu font color red
menu font size 9
menu font style BI
menu text MSTATUS 2 5 Status:
menu text MEVENT 3 20 Event:
menu text CSKILL 275 2 Skill:
menu font style B
menu text CSKILL1 340 2 (
menu text CSKILL2 395 2 )
menu text CSKILL3 378 2 ,
menu font style BI
menu text CGAIN 275 17 Gain:
menu font style B
menu text CGAIN1 340 17 (
menu text CGAIN2 395 17 )
menu text CGAIN3 378 17 ,
menu font style BI
menu text CGAIN3 345 17 +
menu text LOOPS 275 32 Total Attempts:
menu show
menu hideeuo

sub positions

set %statx 50
set %staty 5
set %eventx 50
set %eventy 20
set %s1x 355
set %s1y 2
set %s2x 384
set %s2y 2
set %g1x 355
set %g1y 17
set %g2x 384
set %g2y 17
set %lpcntx 367
set %lpcnty 32

return

sub calculate

chooseskill peace
set %s1 #skill / 10
set %s2 #skill - %s1 * 10
set %total #skill - %orig
set %g1 %total / 10
set %g2 %total - %g1 * 10

if %s1 => 100
set %xmod 0
if %s1 < 100
set %xmod 5
if %s1 < 10
set %xmod 12
set %s1xm %s1x + %xmod

if %g1 => 100
set %xmod 0
if %g1 < 100
set %xmod 5
if %g1 < 10
set %xmod 12
set %g1xm %g1x + %xmod

return

sub initdisplay

menu delete S1
menu text S1 %s1xm %s1y %s1
menu delete S2
menu text S2 %s2x %s2y %s2
menu delete G1
menu text G1 %g1xm %g1y %g1
menu delete G2
menu text G2 %g2x %g2y %g2
menu delete LPCNT
menu text LPCNT %lpcntx %lpcnty %lpcnt

return

sub new_instrument

finditem %items C
if #findkind = -1 5
menu delete STAT
menu delete EVENT
menu text STAT %statx %staty Halted
menu text EVENT %eventx %eventy You are out of instruments!
halt
set #lobjectid #findid
event macro 17
wait 5
target

return
